Paras מָּרַס 28 proper name, of a territory Persia , περσῶν (genitive), Dan 11:2 τῇ Περσίδι ( ᵐ5 and Θ ), 2Chr 36:20 Μήδων (Old Persian Pârsa , Persian, Persia , Spieg APK 231 , New Persian , ; Arabic ; — ׳פ 36:22 +, מָּרָ֑ס 36:20 +; — in late literature, 36:20 , 36:22 , 22 , 23 = Ezra 1:1 (twice in verse); 1:2 ; Dan 10:1 11 t.
